findings.current:
“It’s nice to see you admit I’m right for once. How about lending a hand while I’m here?”

“Lend a hand?”
findings.defect: The draft makes Jin ask Jeong for help; Jin is offering to help Jeong.
findings.rationale: Jeong’s reply, 돕겠다고?, questions Jin’s offer to help.
findings.replacement:
“It’s nice to see you admit I’m right for once. How about I lend you a hand while I’m here?”

“You want to help?”
findings.source:
“모처럼 인정하는 모습이 보기 좋네. 어때, 기왕 온 김에 한 손 거들어 줘?”

“돕겠다고?”

findings.current: Ma Sanbao had moved the East Depot and planted allies where they wouldn’t be seen instead of drawing attention to himself.
findings.defect: The draft says Ma mobilized the East Depot, reversing the stated alternative.
findings.rationale: 동창을 움직여 눈에 띄는 대신 contrasts a conspicuous East Depot intervention with planting unseen allies.
findings.replacement: Rather than mobilize the East Depot and draw attention, Ma Sanbao must have planted allies where no one would notice them.
findings.source: 마삼보는 동창을 움직여 눈에 띄는 대신, 보이지 않는 아군을 심어 둔 것이 틀림없었다.

findings.current: that his circus troupe operated far north of the imperial capital
findings.defect: The draft relocates the troupe north of the capital rather than north of the Yangtze and far from the capital.
findings.rationale: 장강 이북 specifies the Yangtze as the north–south reference; 황도와 엄청나게 떨어진 specifies distance from the capital.
findings.replacement: that his circus troupe operated north of the Yangtze, far from the imperial capital
findings.source: 그들이 속한 마희단은 황도와 엄청나게 떨어진 장강 이북에서 활동하고 있었으며

findings.defect: The draft drops the possessive Jeong objects to and loses Jin’s retort.
findings.rationale: Jeong objects to 우리 호군이; Jin immediately changes 우리 to 느그.
findings.replacement:
“Who are you calling ‘our Hogun’?”

“Fine, then. Your Hogun.”

findings.current: “Captain, you’re absolutely right. I’ll escort you and bring you back in no time, so Deputy Military Commissioner Hong can relax.”
findings.defect: Mujin calls Hong a comrade, not by his official rank; the draft changes the familiarity of his address.
findings.rationale: 홍 동지 is a direct, familiar form of address rather than 홍 부사.
findings.replacement: “Captain, you’re absolutely right. I’ll escort you and bring you back in no time, so Comrade Hong can relax.”
findings.source: ‘조장님 말씀이 백번 옳습니다. 제가 모시고 금방 다녀올 테니 홍 동지께서는 마음 푹 놓고 기다리십쇼.’

findings.current: *That bastard’s going to go start another mess.*
findings.defect: The draft formats Jin’s line as an unspoken thought, though the source presents it as spoken dialogue.
findings.rationale: The source uses dialogue quotation marks here, unlike the marked internal thoughts elsewhere in the passage.
findings.replacement: “That bastard’s going to go start another mess.”
findings.source: ‘이 새끼가 가서 또 무슨 사고를 치려고.’

findings.current: After I’d walked about ten yards
findings.defect: Ten yards substantially understates a distance of a little over ten jang.
findings.rationale: A jang is roughly three meters; 십여 장 is several dozen yards, not ten.
findings.replacement: After I’d walked several dozen yards
findings.source: 그렇게 천천히 십여 장을 걸었을 때쯤

summary: Several scene facts and dialogue cues need correction, especially who offers help, how Ma Sanbao intervened, and where the troupe operates.
